name: EPIC 206102116
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 5.3 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206102116 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.25474 (16th-84th percentiles 5.188358-5.352148), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206102116: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4723.306 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206102116 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1150.263672 (16th-84th percentiles 1135.087891-1167.246094), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.09 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,150 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 5.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,723 K at its surface.
